facts.summary: Topline OS benefit missed conventional significance (p=0.0546) despite company calling it positive · Phase 2b · VCN-01 in metastatic pancreatic cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: had a median OS of 10.8 months [Hazard Ratio (HR) = 0.57, 95% CI 0.34-0.96, p=0.0546].
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Theriva™ Biologics Announces Primary Endpoints for Efficacy and Safety Achieved in VIRAGE Phase 2b Clinical Trial of VCN-01
evidence.safety: VCN-01 was well-tolerated, with transient and reversible adverse events (AEs), meeting primary safety endpoint
